statement: On probe Linux sends valid_flag2 bit 1 with lightbar_setup bit 1 ('light out', fade out) so it can take over the lightbar: on Bluetooth the controller runs its own startup lightbar animation and keeps a colour, on USB the lightbar starts off. SDL instead sends a reset-LED-state request (valid_flag1 bit 3) before its first colour and player-light update.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, VIIPER a370903, nondebug 0233835; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 165-170, 1677-1700, 1863-1872; SDL_hidapi_ps5.c 704-717, 765-776. Consumer behaviour only; the controller's own startup animation is stated by the Linux comment, not observed.
